profile.name: SELIC CORP PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company engages in the manufacturing and distribution of products of the Company and its subsidiaries. Its operations are divided into three main business segments: industrial Adhesives, Stickers or Self-Adhesive labels, and Health Products.
profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has a policy to pay dividends at a rate of not less than 40 percent of the net profit after deduction of all reserves as required by the Company's Articles of Association and applicable laws, based on the separate financial statements, provided that there are no other necessary circumstances and that such dividend payment does not have a significant adverse impact on the Company's normal operations.
